model: TILLREDA 提瑞达 微波炉，白色，20 升，700 瓦
intro_native: 这是宜家的提瑞达微波炉，白色机身，黑色玻璃门。今天我们一起学最常用的功能：加热食物。
intro_en: This is an IKEA TILLREDA microwave with a white body and a black glass door. Today we'll learn the most common task: reheating food.

buttons.function_native: 选择火力大小，从最小到最大共五档，雪花图标是解冻。
buttons.function_en: Sets the power level, five levels from Min to Max; the snowflake icon is defrost.

buttons.function_native: 设定加热时间，0 到 30 分钟。转动后微波炉就开始工作，转回 0 就停止。
buttons.function_en: Sets the cooking time from 0 to 30 minutes. Turning it starts the oven; turning it back to 0 stops it.

steps.narration_native: 先打开炉门。在门右边的白色面板上，最下面有一个圆形的大按钮，按一下，门就打开了。
steps.narration_en: First, open the door. On the white panel to the right of the door, the big round button at the bottom opens it. Just press it once.

steps.action_en: Put the food in and close the door
steps.narration_native: 把食物放进可以微波的碗或盘子里，放在玻璃转盘中间。不要用金属的东西。然后把门用力关紧，门没关好微波炉不会加热。
steps.narration_en: Put the food in a microwave-safe bowl or plate, in the middle of the glass turntable. Don't use anything metal. Then close the door firmly; the oven won't heat if it isn't fully shut.

steps.action_en: Turn the power dial to Max
steps.narration_native: 现在看面板最上面的白色旋钮，这是火力旋钮。加热饭菜一般用最大火，把它转到写着 Max 的位置。
steps.narration_en: Now look at the white dial at the top of the panel. This is the power dial. For reheating, use full power: turn it to Max.

steps.action_native: 转动定时旋钮设定时间
steps.action_en: Turn the timer dial to set the time
steps.narration_native: 中间那个旋钮是定时旋钮，上面的数字是分钟。转到你想要的时间，比如 2 分钟。一转好，微波炉就开始工作了，不需要再按开始。
steps.narration_en: The middle dial is the timer. The numbers are minutes. Turn it to the time you want, for example 2 minutes. As soon as you set it, the oven starts. There's no start button.

steps.narration_native: 时间到了，微波炉会发出“叮”的一声，然后自己停下来。加热时有点蒸汽或者热风都是正常的。
steps.narration_en: When the time is up, the oven makes a ding sound and stops by itself. A little steam or warm air during heating is normal.

steps.action_en: Press the door button and take out the food
steps.narration_native: 再按一下最下面的圆形按钮，把门打开。小心，碗可能很烫，最好用隔热手套。
steps.narration_en: Press the round button at the bottom again to open the door. Careful, the bowl may be hot. Use an oven mitt if you can.

steps.action_native: 提前停止时把定时旋钮转回 0
steps.action_en: If you stop early, turn the timer back to 0
steps.narration_native: 如果你提前开门拿出食物，一定要把中间的定时旋钮转回 0。不然空着的微波炉可能继续运行，会损坏机器。
steps.narration_en: If you open the door early and take the food out, always turn the middle timer dial back to 0. Otherwise the empty oven could run again and get damaged.

tips.native: 解冻时，把火力旋钮转到雪花图标，再设定时间，中途把食物翻一翻。
tips.en: To defrost, turn the power dial to the snowflake icon, then set the time. Turn the food over partway through.

tips.native: 定时旋钮以分钟为单位。不到一分钟的话，可以用手机计时，到时间自己把旋钮转回 0。
tips.en: The timer is marked in minutes. For less than a minute, time it with your phone and turn the dial back to 0 yourself.

tips.native: 设定很短的时间时，可以先转过 2 分钟，再转回你想要的时间，这样会更准一点。
tips.en: For very short times, turn the dial past 2 minutes first, then back to the time you want. It's often more accurate.

tips.native: 爆米花只用最大火 Max，低档火力会时开时停。
tips.en: Use only Max for popcorn; lower settings switch the power on and off.

tips.native: 去除异味：碗里放 300 毫升水和半个柠檬，用最大火加热 10 分钟，再把里面擦干。
tips.en: To remove smells: heat half a lemon in a bowl with 300 ml of water on full power for 10 minutes, then wipe the inside dry.

tips.native: 如果微波炉不工作，先检查插头有没有插紧，再检查电闸。
tips.en: If it won't start, check that the plug is fully in, then check the fuse or breaker.

warnings.native: 不要空着运行微波炉，这非常危险。
warnings.en: Never run the microwave empty. It is very dangerous.

warnings.native: 不要放金属容器、带金边的碗、锡纸或金属扎带，会打火引起火灾。
warnings.en: No metal containers, metal-trimmed dishes, foil or metal twist ties. They can spark and start a fire.

warnings.native: 不要加热带壳的鸡蛋或整个煮鸡蛋，可能会爆炸。
warnings.en: Don't heat eggs in their shells or whole boiled eggs. They can explode.

warnings.native: 热水或热饮拿出来时可能突然沸腾溢出，要小心端。婴儿食品要搅匀并试温度。
warnings.en: Hot drinks can suddenly boil over when moved. Handle carefully. Stir baby food and check the temperature.

warnings.native: 如果看到冒烟，马上关掉或拔掉电源，并保持门关着，让火自己熄灭。
warnings.en: If you see smoke, switch off or unplug the oven and keep the door closed to smother flames.

warnings.native: 清洁前先拔插头，用湿布擦。不要用钢丝球刮玻璃门。
warnings.en: Unplug before cleaning and use a damp cloth. Don't scrape the glass door with metal scrubbers.

warnings.native: 如果微波炉坏了，不要自己拆开外壳修理。请联系宜家官方客服或你的房东。
warnings.en: If the microwave breaks, don't open the casing to repair it. Contact IKEA's official support or your landlord.

closing_native: 做得好！记住：上面的旋钮选火力，中间的旋钮定时间，下面的按钮开门。祝你用餐愉快！
closing_en: Well done! Remember: the top dial sets the power, the middle dial sets the time, and the bottom button opens the door. Enjoy your meal!
